d: Yavnon ko kaee morchon par har ka samna karna par raha hai. is se aahat philipas chintit hai vah apne senapti tyutoras se kahta hai ki use yavnon ki bhul dhire dhire samajh men aa rahi hai. vah sena aur bal ke madhyam se bharat ke rajaon se lar sake par un shikshakon ko andekha kar diya jinhonne janmanas men yavnon ke viruddh ek kranti jaga di - phir kya hota hai dekhie is bhag men.
